investment_strategy: Quality-first A.I. barbell: overweight cash-rich platform leaders monetizing generative A.I. through cloud, productivity, and ads; underweight but include the A.I. silicon leader for asymmetric upside. Use the recent tech correction (NASDAQ −13.7% in 30 days, VIX ~22) as a better entry while sizing risk to macro volatility and 4.25% yields. Focus on durable free cash flow, strong execution, and positive analyst support; manage regulatory/export-control risks and capex digestion. Rebalance quarterly; trim if any single name exceeds +35% gain from cost or breaches −20% from cost; reassess on regulatory events or major guidance changes.
